// Probe for tests/unit/document-gate-storage-single-path.test.ts — RED. A
// policy document reaches the private bucket from outside the ingestion
// service: two call shapes, both flagged (the default folder IS "policies").
import { uploadFile, uploadFileDetailed } from "@/lib/storage"

export async function storeExplicit(file: File) {
    return uploadFileDetailed(file, "policies")
}
export async function storeByDefault(file: File) {
    return uploadFile(file)
}
